name: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
description: Implement a thread-safe token bucket rate limiter in `app.py`. The `TokenBucket(capacity, refill_rate)` class must replenish tokens over time based on `refill_rate` (tokens per second) up to `capacity`. The `consume(tokens=1)` method must return `True` and deduct tokens if enough tokens are available, or `False` if insufficient tokens exist. Ensure negative or zero capacity/refill_rate raises `ValueError`.
visible_hint: Consuming 1 token from a full bucket of capacity 5 should succeed and leave 4 tokens.
